subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `AgentToolResult.control` plus `yieldToolResult(...)` as the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for cooperative turn handoff?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and well proven, but it permanently expands the public Plugin SDK and defines how plugins request host scheduling behavior, so repository owners must confirm the API direction.

options.title: Accept the result-control contract
options.body: Keep the post-finalization control seam, require yielding tools to declare sequential execution, and fix the public example before merge.

options.title: Use an imperative context API
options.body: Replace the result field with a plugin-context yield method, accepting weaker coupling between successful result persistence and the scheduling request.

options.title: Defer the public API
options.body: Pause this PR and keep external interaction plugins on model-selected `sessions_yield` until a broader interaction contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept the result-control contract
recommendation.body: Keep the post-finalization control seam, require yielding tools to declare sequential execution, and fix the public example before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest ownership of the embedded agent runtime and public runtime-package boundary affected by this decision.
